items.text: New trade idea: Jordyn Tyson + Zay Flowers for Dak Prescott + Blake Corum

take: You're in (99.8%) but the bye isn't safe yet (58.7%). Regular season wins still matter a lot.
You win it all in 33.6% of sims. Your biggest threat is Tyler's Talented Team at 27.6%.
Best trade they'd likely accept (66% yes): Zay Flowers for Dak Prescott with Tyler's Talented Team. Title odds +3.1.
Backup plan: Jordyn Tyson + Colston Loveland for George Kittle (Big Deal Neil), +4.2.
Swing big if they bite: Zay Flowers + Jaylen Warren for Chuba Hubbard (Big Deal Neil) is worth +10.9, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: Trevor Lawrence getting hurt costs you 21.0% in title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
